name: feature-scout
description: Competitor analysis, idea scouting and clone specs in the browser: explores logged-in dashboards and websites (view only, never triggers anything) in three modes — comparison with your own project plus build plan, ideas when you haven't built anything yet, or a complete rebuild specification with every field, value and formula. German and English. Made by Sertac · NetBoosting GmbH (https://netboosting.de).
